characters.name: Ember Scout
characters.prompt: Use case: identity-preserve. Asset type: transparent animation sprite atlas for the existing browser card game 100. Input image 1 is the existing character sheet to COPY for character identity, exact painterly cartoon illustration style, face, skin, hair, gender, age, accessories, outfit, warm rim lighting, held ornate card backs, and sprite scale. Make a NEW separate TUMBLE BACKWARDS animation sheet of this same character. Match the existing 3-by-3 layout: EXACTLY THREE columns and THREE rows, nine equally sized square cells, read left to right, top to bottom. All poses have fixed straight-on camera, same figure scale and body proportions, centered in each cell with ample transparent padding. The character sits behind a card-game table in the game, so begin with the SAME waist-to-head framing and face size as the reference. Animate falling BACKWARDS AWAY FROM THE VIEWER off their unseen chair, tipping the torso back in depth, NOT merely rotating the flat image sideways. Legs/boots must suit this exact costume. During later frames the head descends within its cell while feet rise, leaving transparent upper space. No visible chair or table: the actual game table supplies the foreground occlusion. No ground, background, scenery, labels, grid lines, borders, or text. Every face/hair/shoulder/arm/hand/boot and flying card is FULLY contained within its cell with at least 5% transparent gutter, NO cropping at sides or top, NO overlapping cells. Genuine transparent alpha PNG, square output ideally1536x1536. Preserve recognizable character in every frame, clean illustrated edges, comedic harmless fall, no injury, no gore, no added characters.
